a new routing environment model is needed for MCM routing, a detailed layer assignment problem can be formulated, a fast heuristic algorithm can be proposed, and experimental results can be presented.

a new routing environment model called the k-M CM model is developed to take account of the unique features of an MCM, such a s the availability of “segregated vias” and the presence of terminal-bearing layers.
the k-MCM routing environment model and the proposed heuristic algorithm for the detailed layer assignment problem can be applied to a variety of MCM routing problems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a detailed routing problem for MCMs with a large number of layers.
the development of a new routing environment model for MCMs, and with the formulation and solution of the detailed layer assignment problem on the new model.
the development of a new model for multilayer M CM routing, and a fast algorithm for detailed layer assignment on this model.
